listing.name: Monster Hunter Freedom Unite — MHForever (Mango77x)
listing.summary: Only MHFUEurope supported; playableclaimed, other planned games/regions are not targets. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European ULES01213 v1.01 game as an uncompressed ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the runtime from Releases and add your own ISO. Linux requires WebKitGTK 4.1 and GTK 3.

warnings: Only the European Monster Hunter Freedom Unite is supported by this project. The project describes it as playable; other planned games and regions are not supported targets.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
